C339.reason: Derived deformation rings R^bullet and spectral moduli of Galois representations factor through the Galois representation rho_bar: G_Q -> GL_2(F_p) of the Frey curve over Q. Because non-zero scaling factors d in Z are units in the fraction field Q, the Galois representation and its derived deformation ring are projective invariants, strictly blind to integer coprimality gcd(A, B, C) = 1 in Z. Spectral Galois moduli cannot bound exponents or enforce coprimality.
